title: Insulin action times

findings.where: Amber peak bands and risk swatches in both themes; Curve() peak rectangle and G id="peak-risk".
findings.title: Amber overlays fail the project's 4.5:1 contrast requirement
findings.problem: The 55%-opacity amber fill reduces contrast where the curves cross the peak bands. In dark mode, accent ink against the composited amber fill is approximately 3.2:1, and the lab-ink outline is approximately 3.1:1. In light mode, the lab-ink outline against the amber fill is approximately 3.6:1. The source comment claiming these elements retain 4.5:1 is incorrect.
findings.fix: Reduce the amber fill opacity and/or add contrasting separation around the curve and band boundaries. Measure the final composited colors, including underlying area fills, in both themes; update the contrast assertion and test.

assessment: One confirmed contrast-rule violation. No clinical blocker or incorrect clock-window calculation was found for the four supported insulin types.
